children: Adentra's $164 million acquisition of AccessSMT adds a Canadian commercial openings platform spanning doors, frames, hardware and access control, according to National Bank of Canada in a report. It should also drive an 11% boost to 2027 adjusted EPS, according to analyst Zachary Evershed. He says the deal extends the specialty building products company's services from specification and fabrication through pre-assembly, delivery, installation and maintenance, helping to "capture value-add through installation and ongoing service." Moreover, he notes Adentra's commercial business is expected to grow to 18% of sales from roughly 13%, while Canadian sales double to 14%. Evershed lifts his price target to C$59 from C$52 and reiterates an outperform rating. Adentra jumps 10% to C$41.92. (adriano.marchese@wsj.com)
